_comment: compose-program job — build a program-template from EXISTING exercises.
Runner: scripts/runners/compose_program.py (kind: compose-program).
It verifies each exercise draft, creates one program-exercise-template join
per exercise (with the full dosing quintet), then the program-template that
links the joins. Every write lands as a DRAFT; publishing is a separate
publish-chain job after the physio signs off.
'_comment' is ignored by the runner — it reads only the keys below via plan.get().
Fields:
kind                 : must be 'compose-program' (run_job.py dispatches on it).
env                  : MCP registration name; `--env` on the CLI overrides it.
program.name         : program-template.name (required).
program.duration     : integer, required.
program.durationType : enum days | weeks | months | years (required).
program.body_regions / joints / functional_goals / reasons : optional arrays
of canonical names, resolved to relations at run time (omit or [] if none).
sessions_per_week    : integer >= 1; weeklyReps = sets * reps * sessions_per_week.
exercises[]          : one entry per existing exercise —
carespaceId : integer, the exercise's id (used for logging + step keys),
documentId  : the exercise's documentId -> join.strapiExerciseId,
sets, reps  : integers (dailyReps = sets * reps),
order       : integer, UNIQUE across the list (step key is join:<order>).
Resolve each documentId via list_exercise at plan time and replace the
placeholders below before running.

exercises.documentId: <documentId — resolve via list_exercise at plan time>
<documentId — resolve via list_exercise at plan time>
